overall_notes: The paper is primarily focused on Text-to-Speech (TTS) generation and evaluation. The extraction was generally accurate with minor normalization needed. The paper uses both automatic metrics (WER) and human evaluation (preference tests) to assess TTS quality. No LLM-based evaluation was conducted. The metadata accurately reflects the paper's contributions to low-resource TTS with articulatory features and meta-learning.
